# Build NodeJS REST API

> Create a RESTful API using NodeJS and Express to manage data. This API will allow users to perform CRUD operations, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting data.

**Generated by [BuildBridge](https://github.com/researchsite)**

## Prerequisites

- **NodeJS**: `npm install node`
- **Express**: `npm install express`

## Steps

### 1. Initialize a new NodeJS project
```bash
npm init -y
```
> Create a new project folder and run this command

### 2. Install Express
```bash
npm install express
```
> Install Express to create the API

### 3. Create a new Express app
```bash
const express = require('express'); const app = express();
```
> Create a new JavaScript file and add this code

### 4. Define API routes
```bash
app.get('/api/data', (req, res) => { res.send('Hello World'); });
```
> Add routes to handle different API requests

### 5. Start the Express server
```bash
app.listen(3000, () => { console.log('Server started on port 3000'); });
```
> Start the server to test the API

## Stack

- NodeJS
- Express

## Estimate

~30 minutes | **beginner**
